title: Milan Design Week Wrap Up
bodyHtml:
Salone del Mobile 2024 - Full Recap

We are back from Milan with a full recap of our action packed week taking in the latest innovations and trends shaping the future of bathrooms at the world's biggest design fair - Salone del Mobile 2024.

Read on to see what our design team found as we engaged with our esteemed manufacturing partners and prospective collaborators at the fair, exploring the forefront of bathroom design in 2024.

Trending in Bathroom Design 2024

Among the myriad of product displays on offer, several captivating themes emerged, each signalling a world of opportunities for the future of bathroom design.

Here are the top trends we noticed for Bathrooms in 2024 and beyond:

1. Matte White Endures

Matte White continued to reign supreme, with an increasing demand for its timeless and tactile allure. Major Italian designers showcased a plethora of new ceramic designs, reaffirming Matte White's enduring popularity.

2. Elevated Gloss Colours

Pastel and earthy gloss hues were the dominant new colour trend in fixtures such as basins and toilets, reflecting a growing preference for sophisticated gloss colours in bathroom design, an evolution in design preference away from the more common, softer matte hues we’ve seen in recent years.

3. Tornado Flush

The Tornado flush, also known as 'Vortex Flush' is a groundbreaking innovation, garnering a heap of attention as it moves towards mass market adoption.

This revolutionary flushing system projects water in a vortex-like motion, facilitating a clean and seamless rim design that is both easy to maintain and remarkably quiet in operation. (Look out for Studio Bagno’s upcoming release shortly!)

4. Structure Vanities

Structure vanities emerged as a dominant trend, offering unique and space-saving solutions for wash area furniture. Cleverly integrated with wash basins, these vanities boasted innovative designs and compact footprints, catering to the evolving needs of modern bathrooms.

5. Integrated Vanity Tops

Larger-width vanity tops featuring innovative surfaces like porcelain stole the spotlight, offering a seamless blend of functionality and aesthetics. Available in a variety of finishes that harmonized beautifully with natural stone, these integrated vanity tops showcased the boundless potential of bathroom design.
